title: Introduce compact event indexer and alert quiescer for noisy token spikes
author: Priya Ramachandran
description: Context: Token-level telemetry and sampled logs have become a major driver of metrics cardinality and dashboard noise for long-tail customers. Frequent short-lived token spikes (e.g., multi-token bursts from streaming clients) were triggering noisy paging and masking real regressions. Motivation: Reduce ingestion and dashboard noise while preserving investigatability: compact frequently-repeating event sequences into an indexable compact snapshot, surface token-phase sparklines on per-route panels, and add an alert quiescer that automatically suppresses repeated short-lived spikes for a configurable window. This PR implements a compact event indexer service, a lightweight per-invocation snapshot format, dashboard panels, and an alert quiescer + rollout plan. Key changes (high level): - Introduce compact event indexer microservice (telemetry/compact-index) that consumes sampled spans and log fragments, performs deduplication of recurring token-phase sequences, and emits compact snapshots keyed by (tenant, route, token_phase_hash). - Add an invocation-level snapshot format (span.attributes.compact_snapshot_ref) that stores a 128-bit stable ref and small metadata (seq_count, top_tokens, estimated_cost_cents) to avoid embedding full token sequences in traces. Snapshots are retained in a TTL-backed store for 7 days by default. - Emit a new span attribute request.token_cost_cents and request.token_phase_map to improve per-span cost and phase decomposition for downstream rollups. - Dashboard: new "Token Phase Sparklines" row on per-route dashboard that uses compact snapshot refs to render per-phase small-multiples and a compact noise metric. - Alert quiescer: an alert middleware that detects repeated bursts from the same token_phase_hash and suppresses firing if bursts are < 5s and occur within a 60s window (configurable per-tenant). - Telemetry: histograms for compact_index_hit_rate, snapshot_store_size_bytes, quiescer_suppressed_count added to prometheus exporters and per-tenant rollups. Why this is different: instead of increasing sampling or broad downsampling (which loses fidelity), the indexer preserves the ability to inspect exact example sequences via snapshot refs while dramatically lowering cardinality in primary telemetry paths. Backwards compatibility: Old spans without compact_snapshot_ref are still fully supported; compaction is opt-in per-tenant during rollout. Rollout plan: 1) Canary deployment in telemetry/canary (48h) with quiescer off and sampling at 1% for snapshots. 2) Enable compact snapshots for 5 pilot tenants, monitor compact_index_hit_rate and snapshot retrieval latencies. 3) Gradually increase snapshot sampling to 10% and enable quiescer with default thresholds. Migration notes: - Snapshot references are opaque; UI and on-call runbooks updated to resolve a snapshot via the compact-index service when a user clicks a sparkline. - Short-term storage cost (~+2-3% telemetry storage) expected during ramp; long-term cardinality reduction reduces downstream storage by ~10-20% for heavy-tail routes. Testing: - Unit tests for compaction/dedup logic and hash stability across CPU endianness. - Integration tests that verify span attribute injection, snapshot store retrieval, and per-route dashboard rendering in storybook. - Load bench: simulated 10k/s sampled spans with 20% repeated sequences; compaction reduced exported sample count to telemetry backend by ~58% and decreased Grafana panel query times by ~22%. Rollback: disable compaction in config and backfill spans remain unaffected. Observability & alerting: added ephemeral SLOs to monitor snapshot store latency (p50 < 30ms), hit_rate > 0.6 after pilot, and quiescer suppression rate. Security & privacy: snapshots redact PII following existing redact pipeline; snapshot store enforces tenant-scoped ACLs and KMS encryption at rest. Checklist: - [x] Compact indexer service implemented - [x] Snapshot format v1 defined and gated - [x] Dashboard rows + panels added - [x] Quiescer middleware wired into alerts - [x] Tests and load bench results attached - [x] Rollout plan documented in PR body Related work: ENG-4721 (telemetry cardinality), PM-198 (product request: quieter alerts).

release_notes: Adds compact event snapshot indexing to reduce telemetry cardinality for repeated token-phase sequences, a per-invocation compact_snapshot_ref attribute, and an alert quiescer to suppress short noisy token bursts. Dashboards updated with Token Phase Sparklines. Opt-in rollout and tenant configuration provided.
notes_for_oncall: If rollout causes missing context in traces, disable compact snapshots via the observability feature flag for the tenant and query snapshot-store directly to retrieve snapshot by ref. Monitor compact_index_hit_rate and quiescer_suppressed_count for unexpected drops or spikes.
